text:
Elena: quick sync on soft-reserve accounting + SLA escape hatch follow-up
Mark: awesome. TL;DR?
Elena: two problems: (1) soft-reserves improve coalesce but bloat KV and memory; (2) fairness gets fuzzy because soft attempts are fractional
Jon: can we treat soft attempts as "probationary" tokens that don't affect hard share but count to a lightweight soft ledger?
Priya: yes but ledger needs decay so tenants cant spam soft tokens forever. propose exponential decay per-minute
Mark: also need SLA escape: some routes are latency-sensitive and should bypass soft gating; but bypass must be auditable and charged
Elena: agreed. plan: route-level flag QoS_bypass=true. When used increment route_bypass_counter and emit audit event. Ops can set alert thresholds
Jon: fairness math: when a soft token promotes to hard, convert using factor alpha (0<alpha<=1). repeated soft-only attempts get diminishing alpha (e.g., alpha_n = alpha_0 * 0.5^n)
Priya: examples: tenant does 4 soft attempts, only 1 promotion -> ledger sees alpha_0 for first promotion, next promotions lower weight. prevents gaming
Mark: eviction interaction: we observed churn when many soft tokens canceled but left ephemeral KV entries that triggered eviction heuristics
Elena: mitigation: mark ephemeral KV entries with TTL and low eviction priority; also expose metric ephemeral_kv_bytes by tenant
Jon: rollout: feature flag soft_reserve_accounting; canary on 2 shards for 48h. Start with N_soft=3, T_soft=30ms, alpha_0=0.5
Priya: metrics to add: soft_attempts, soft_promotions, soft_promotion_alpha, tenant_soft_penalty, ephemeral_kv_bytes, route_bypass_uses
Mark: alerts/rollback: if ephemeral_kv_bytes > baseline*1.4 for 15m OR per-shard evictions > baseline*1.3 -> rollback
Elena: SLA escape policy: only service owners can request QoS_bypass; auto-expire after 24h unless renewed; infra-oncall will receive audits when used
infra-oncall: noted. we'll add a short approval flow + auto-notify channel @infra-oncall when bypass requested
Jon: implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
on_request(req):
  if route.QoS_bypass and approved(req.route):
    grant_hard(req)
    emit_audit(req.route, req.tenant)
    route_bypass_counter++
  else if tenant.soft_count < N_soft and heuristic(req):
    issue_soft(req)
  else
    queue_hard(req)

on_soft_timeout(token):
  if batch.size >= K:
    promote(token)
    ledger.hard += alpha_for(token.tenant)
  else:
    release(token)
    ledger.apply_decay(token.tenant)
```
Elena: note alpha_for should use tenant history: alpha_n = alpha_0 * decay_factor^promotions_in_window
Priya: ops note: add trace id reservation_id -> batch_id -> eviction_id in logs for debugging
Mark: long-term: replace heuristic(req) with model.predict_coalesce(req) and tie alpha to model confidence
Jon: agree. also add admin knob to convert soft_attempts into billable metric if product wants to monetize
infra-oncall: can we get an estimated mem delta for N_soft=3? we need to pre-approve capacity increase if >10%
Elena: rough estimate: ~6-9% per-shard in worst case; will run more sims and post numbers in RFC
Priya: I'll wire dashboards and alert rules for the rollout. also add a runbook for manual revoke of QoS_bypass
Elena: I'll open the RFC with invariants, ledger math, pseudo-code, telemetry list, and rollout playbook. ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
